# hamz.ai

> hamz.ai is an AI implementation studio founded by Hamza Malik. We design, build, and ship production LLM systems, and we hold every deliverable to a public review standard called the Assurance Chain: adversarial review, tiered escalation, an evidence harness, and production security controls. Decisions are settled by evidence, not opinion.

hamz.ai builds multi-model Claude architectures, eval harnesses, production reliability and cost controls, and interactive single-file tools. The founder, Hamza Malik, is an aerospace engineer, former KPMG senior technology consultant, and MIT Sloan MBA candidate (2027) who is co-developing a new MIT Sloan course on leading agentic AI transformation in organizations.

## Site

- [hamz.ai root](https://www.hamz.ai/): The studio's front page. Recent work, services, the assurance chain, and an FAQ.
- [Builder](https://www.hamz.ai/builder/): What Hamza is building this month, the numbers he is free to publish, and what he has shipped. Updated monthly and dated. Available full-time June 2027.

## The lab

- [The Lab](https://www.hamz.ai/lab/): Hamza's lab, where he shares his research and work on how AI systems actually behave. The work he does for clients is private, but the standards it passes, his methodology, and the research he does on his own are not.
- [The effort lattice](https://www.hamz.ai/lab/lattice/): Does turning up reasoning effort replace skills? A pre-registered lattice across three Claude models at five effort levels each, plus Haiku as a fixed baseline, run cold and loaded. Effort bought capability; it did not buy back what the skills add.
- [The effort lattice, guided tour](https://www.hamz.ai/lab/lattice/visual/): The same study as a scrollytelling 3D walkthrough: the suite gets built, the matrix runs, the judges score it, the verdict settles.
- [The effort lattice, explorer](https://www.hamz.ai/lab/lattice/explorer/): An interactive per-cell explorer over the same matrix data. Noindex by design (a tool, not an article).
- [The skills library](https://www.hamz.ai/lab/skills/): The 17 released Claude Code skills, searchable, each with its own SKILL.md and its evidence note where one exists.
- [How this works](https://www.hamz.ai/lab/learn/): What a Claude Code skill actually is, how a skill gets tested, and a glossary of the other terms used across the lab, written for a reader without the technical background.
- [The Assurance Chain](https://www.hamz.ai/lab/chain/): The standard every deliverable passes before it reaches a client, with the public receipt behind each stage. Adversarial review, tiered escalation, evidence harness, security controls.
- [The skills study](https://www.hamz.ai/lab/evidence/): Do Claude Code skills change agent behavior? An order-blinded A/B across 50 pre-registered must-hits in 16 tasks. Baseline 26 of 50; with the library, 46 of 50.
- [Field notes](https://www.hamz.ai/lab/notes/): Dated write-ups from the hamz.ai practice, newest first. Each note carries its position on the same review ladder the client work climbs.
- [Artifacts](https://www.hamz.ai/lab/#proof): The two repos behind the lab: the open-source skills library with its eval harness, and a working prototype. Both clonable.

## Guides

- [Designing agentic systems](https://www.hamz.ai/designing-agentic-ai/): Field guide on choosing the shape of an agentic system: one agent or many, and where a step should stay plain code instead of a model. Originally built as an interactive primer on context allocation, model routing, and orchestration for MIT Sloan course 15.S50.
- [The same guide, in 3D](https://www.hamz.ai/designing-agentic-ai/visual/): The field guide as a spatial, walkable Three.js build. One inbound call, shaped five different ways.

## Work

- [Overnight AI pipeline for a business-coaching company](https://www.hamz.ai/work/coaching-platform/): An anonymized case study. A coach cockpit, a client portal, and an overnight pipeline that turns every session into a review-and-approve step by morning, projected to give each coach 11.5 hours a week back.
- [BD automation for a capital-markets advisory firm](https://www.hamz.ai/work/advisory-overnight/): An anonymized case study. Business development automation and AI enablement inside a customized Dynamics 365 environment: market events become tracked records that cannot silently expire, and AI-drafted outreach queues behind human review. Delivered across a seven-phase roadmap.
- [Trip-feasibility engine for a business-aviation operator](https://www.hamz.ai/work/aviation-operations/): An anonymized case study. A 16-check trip-feasibility engine over 10+ enterprise data sources, with human override as a first-class citizen.
- [Case playtesting](https://www.hamz.ai/case-playtesting/): A method for pressure-testing decision materials against a simulated panel of AI personas before they meet a real audience.
- [Clara](https://www.hamz.ai/clara/): A prototype that reads hard mail, classifies it, and explains it back in plain language with audio and deadline reminders.

## Open source

- [Reliable AI Skills](https://github.com/HamzaYM/reliable-ai-skills): 26 skills from two production codebases, distilled into 17 portable Claude Code skills (9 merges, 6 carried over, 2 new from the maintainer's own tooling, 1 dropped). 8 of the 26 sources were validated with an order-blinded A/B and all 8 passed. MIT licensed.
- [Clara (source)](https://github.com/HamzaYM/clara): A working prototype that reads dense official mail (government, health, financial) and explains it back in plain language.
